Problem Statement:
Save the string “WELCOMETOGUVICORPORATIONS” in a two dimensional array of size (5*5) and search for the given substring. If it exists print the start index and end index in the matrix in separate lines. If it does not exist print 0. 
Input Description:
The input consists of a substring to be searched within the 5x5 matrix. 
Output Description:
If the substring is found, print its start index and end index in the matrix on separate lines. Otherwise, print 0. 
Sample Input:
TIO 
Sample Output:
4 0
4 2
